datasets.name: Accounts
datasets.sql:
SELECT p.boorowerid,
       b.name,
       a.creditid,
     a.booroweraccid ,
     a.loanaccid, 
     a.dueloanaccid   ,
     a.interestaccid ,
     a.dueinterestaccid,                      
     a.primaryreserveaccid ,      
     a.secondaryreserveaccid,             
     a.secondarypurreserveaccid ,     
     a.primarypurreserveaccid ,
     a.doublepaymentaccid,a.insuranceaccid,a.commissionobligationaccid,a.tranzitaccid,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(booroweraccid) as BoorowerAccno,   
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(loanaccid) as LoanAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(dueloanaccid) as DueloanAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(interestaccid) as InterestAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(dueinterestaccid) as DueinterestAccno,  
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(primaryreserveaccid) as PrimaryresAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(secondaryreserveaccid) as SecondaryresAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(secondarypurreserveaccid) as secondarypurreserveAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(primarypurreserveaccid) as primarypurreserveAccno,
     
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(doublepaymentaccid) as doublepaymentaccidAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(insuranceaccid) as insuranceaccidAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(commissionobligationaccid) as commissionobligationaccidAccno,
     cm_common.AccountNumber_Get(tranzitaccid) as tranzitaccidAccno,
     
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(booroweraccid) as BoorowerRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(loanaccid) as LoanRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(dueloanaccid) as dueloanRest, 
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(interestaccid) as interestRest, 
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(dueinterestaccid) as dueinterestRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(primaryreserveaccid) as primaryresRest, 
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(secondaryreserveaccid) as secondaryresRest, 
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(secondarypurreserveaccid) as secondarypurreserveRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(primarypurreserveaccid) as primarypurreserveRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(doublepaymentaccid) as doublepaymentaccidRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(insuranceaccid) as insuranceaccidRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(commissionobligationaccid) as commissionobligationaccidRest,
     cm_common.AccountRest_Get(tranzitaccid) as tranzitaccidRest
     
  FROM cm_accounts a,
       cm_boorowerinfo b,
       cm_portfolio p
where a.creditid = :CrdID
and  b.creditid  = :CrdID
and p.id = :Crdid
